deploy.startCommand: bash -c 'pip3 install --break-system-packages -q google-api-python-client google-auth google-auth-httplib2 google-auth-oauthlib 2>/dev/null; PW=$(node -e "try{console.log(require(\x27/usr/local/lib/node_modules/openclaw/node_modules/playwright-core/package.json\x27).version)}catch(e){console.log(\x27latest\x27)}" 2>/dev/null || echo latest); npx playwright@$PW install-deps chromium 2>&1 | tail -2; export PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/data/.playwright; CHROME=$(find /data/.playwright -name chrome -type f 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -z "$CHROME" ]; then echo Installing Chromium...; npx playwright@$PW install chromium 2>&1 | tail -3; CHROME=$(find /data/.playwright -name chrome -type f 2>/dev/null | head -1); fi; [ -n "$CHROME" ] && ln -sf "$CHROME" /usr/local/bin/chromium; exec /entrypoint.sh'
